variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Home world declines route expansion request
variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: No assent to the colony's shipping plea
